Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: Binance’s Community 3rd Appreciation Campaign
Start: 2026-10-30T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-11T23:59:00Z
Smallest threshold (parsed): 0.01 USD (hold)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
To thank users for their continued trust and support, Binance is launching another community appreciation campaign. Eligible users are able to enjoy up to 15% APR.
Activity 1: Hold USD1 in Spot, Margin, Futures, Funding and Earn Accounts to Enjoy Up to 10% APR, No Individual Reward Cap
Promotion Period: 2026-11-10 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-04 00:00 (UTC)
The ongoing USD1 Airdrop Campaign has been upgraded with added rewards on top of the original pool and extended campaign duration.
## Total Reward Pool
The Original WLFI Rewards Portion for All Holdings expanded to 120 million WLFI tokens and 7 million USD1, with no individual cap on rewards.
The Original USD1 Rewards Portion for “First-Time USD1 Users” and “Incremental USD1 Holdings”: no change, same up to 2.5million USD1. Only the first 50,000 new/incremental USD1 per user will receive the rewards.
Expanded eligible account coverage to all Binance Accounts, starting from 2026-11-10 00:00 (UTC), including Spot, Margin, Futures, Funding and Earn Accounts
Estimated APR: Up to 10% APR
120 million WLFI and 7 million USD1 Rewards Portion for All Holdings: Estimated 5%
Up to 2.5 million USD1 Rewards Portion for “First-Time USD1 Users” and “Incremental USD1 Holdings”: Up to 3%
Earn base APR: Around 2.3%
## Reward Distribution Schedule
Period | Rewards | Distribution Date
Reward Period: 2026-10-30 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-06 00:00 (UTC) | Share 30 million WLFI.Note: Enrollment window for “First-Time USD1 Users” and “Incremental USD1 Holdings” Rewards | Rewards distribution completed on 2026-11-06
Reward Period: 2026-11-06 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-10 00:00 (UTC)(4 days) | Share 17.14 million WLFI.Note: Enrollment window for “First-Time USD1 Users” and “Incremental USD1 Holdings” Rewards | 2026-11-20
Reward Period: 2026-11-10 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-20 00:00 (UTC)(10 days) | Share 30.36 million WLFI, and 2.92 million USD1 Note: Enrollment window for “First-Time USD1 Users” and “Incremental USD1 Holdings” Rewards
Reward Period: 2026-11-20 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-27 00:00 (UTC) | Share 21.25 million WLFI, and 2.04 million USD1 Note: Enrollment window for “First-Time USD1 Users” and “Incremental USD1 Holdings” Rewards | 2026-11-27
Reward Period: 2026-11-27 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-04 00:00 (UTC) | Share 21.25 million WLFI, and 2.04 million USD1 Note: Enrollment window (extended) for “First-Time USD1 Users” and “Incremental USD1 Holdings” Rewards | 2026-12-04
2026-11-13: There will be no reward distribution on 2026-11-13.
All other terms follow the original campaign rules.
## Activity 2: Hold USDe and Enjoy Up to 10% APR
Promotion Period: 2026-11-11 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-30 23:59 (UTC)
During the Promotion Period, eligible users who hold a minimum of 0.01 USDe for at least 24 hours will be eligible to enjoy up to 10% APR.
Products | Eligible User | Total APR = Base APR + Bonus Tiered APR
USDe | All Users | Base APR (Updated weekly, currently 5.25%) | Bonus Tiered APR (4.75%) (Tier 0 - 100,000 USDe)
## Activity 3: Subscribe to KGST Flexible Products to Enjoy Up to 15% APR
Promotion Period: 2026-11-12 08:00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-11 23:59:59 (UTC)
Subscription Format: Complete subscription, and rewards are available to eligible participants on a first-come, first-served basis in accordance with the terms below.
Products | Eligible User | APR During Promotion Period | Min. Subscription Limit per User | Max. Subscription Limit per User
Tier Range: Subscription Amount ≤ 100,000 KGST | Tier Range: 100,000 KGST < Subscription Amount
KGST Flexible | All Users | 15% (including 10% Bonus Tiered APR and 5% Real-Time APR) | 5% 5% Real-Time APR | 1 KGST | 1,500,000 KGST
## Terms & Conditions
## Activity 2, USDe Bonus Tiered APR:
How to participate: Get USDe by trading USDe on the Spot Market, via the Buy Crypto page, or depositing USDe to your Binance account.
Only master accounts are eligible for the Bonus Tiered APR. USDe held in sub-accounts will continue to earn Base APR only and will not be included in the Bonus Tiered APR calculation
Eligible balance: USDe in Spot, Funding and Margin Accounts, including USDe used as collateral. Borrowed USDe and USDe held outside Binance are not eligible.
Bonus tiered APR: Daily Bonus Rewards = Min(minimum snapshot of the day's USDe balance, 100,000 USDe) * 4.75% / 365. Users whose USDe balances are above 100,000 will earn Base APR only.
## Reward distribution:
Base APR rewards are paid weekly in USDe to eligible users' Spot Accounts every Monday.
Bonus Tiered APR rewards will be distributed in USDe as a one-time payment to users' Spot Accounts within 14 business days after the Promotion Period ends.
Users who borrow via Binance Loans or Margin to hold USDe for arbitrage are not eligible for Bonus Tiered APR. Distributed rewards will be deducted.
For more USDe related product information please refer to this FAQ.
This Activity is subject to the USDe Campaign Terms & Conditions.
## Activity 3, KGST Bonus Tiered APR:
Only master accounts are eligible for the Bonus Tiered APR. Sub-accounts will not be included in the bonus reward calculation.
## Reward Distribution:
Real-Time APR: Rewards are accrued and directly accumulated in eligible users’ Earn Accounts every minute. Real-Time APR is subject to change every minute, please refer to the respective product page(s) for full information.
Bonus Tiered APR: Rewards will be distributed to eligible users’ Spot Accounts every day. The first reward will be given the day after accrual starts (two days after subscription). For more calculation details, please refer to this FAQ.
All users who hold open positions for KGST Flexible Products will receive both Real-Time APR and Bonus Tiered APR rewards during the Promotion Period. Once the Promotion ends, users will be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards only.
A large amount of redemption requests might delay redemption temporarily. Redemptions may resume upon return of liquidity.
Users can view their Flexible Products assets by going to Assets > Earn > Simple Earn.
Redemption time for Flexible Products subscriptions: Instant.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
